**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/03/17 (Fri) 02:43
- [USER] User asked how to make Bosnian cevapi.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] To make Bosnian cevapi, you will need the following ingredients: 
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] 500 g of minced meat (usually a combination of beef, lamb, and pork)
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] 1 onion, finely chopped
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] 2 cloves of garlic, minced
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] 1 teaspoon of salt
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] 1/2 teaspoon of black pepper
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] 1/2 teaspoon of ground paprika
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] 1/4 teaspoon of cayenne pepper
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] 1/4 teaspoon of ground cumin
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] 1/4 teaspoon of baking soda
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Mix the minced meat, onion, garlic, salt, black pepper, paprika, cayenne pepper, cumin, and baking soda in a bowl until well combined.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Cover the mixture and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] To shape the cevapi, wet your hands with water and take small handfuls of the meat mixture.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Shape into long, thin cylinders, about the thickness of your finger.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Heat the vegetable oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] When the oil is hot, add the cevapi and cook for about 5 minutes on each side, or until they are nicely browned and cooked through.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Serve the cevapi hot with a side of onions, sour cream, and/or ajvar (a roasted red pepper sauce).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Enjoy!
